description: Change when a schedule runs: its type, time, time zone, days or day of the month. Only the fields you give change; the next run time is worked out again. What it runs does not change: delete it and make a new one for another test or suite. To switch it off or on, use set_schedule_active.

day_of_month.description: For monthly: the day of the month.
day_of_month.title: Day Of Month

days.description: For weekly: the days, 0 for Monday to 6 for Sunday.
days.title: Days

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

schedule.description: The schedule's id, as list_schedules shows it.
schedule.title: Schedule

schedule_type.description: once (at the next such time), daily, weekly (on days) or monthly (on day_of_month).
schedule_type.title: Schedule Type

timezone.description: An IANA time zone, such as Europe/Berlin.
timezone.title: Timezone

name: update_schedule
